guided_filter.expected_derivation: Independent scalar evaluation of the guided-filter equations; each normalized 3x3 box mean enumerates samples with BORDER_REFLECT_101, and coefficient means use a second scalar box pass.

multiscale_band.expected_derivation: Input minus an independently evaluated radius-1 self-guided smooth, using scalar reflected box means and the variance/covariance equations. The radius-0 fine smooth is the input by definition.

color_adapter.expected_derivation: Canonical Oklab equations applied independently to the four sRGB primaries/white: piecewise sRGB decoding, the published linear-sRGB-to-LMS and cube-root-LMS-to-Oklab matrices, evaluated in float64.
